rows.ja: 提携・連携・資金調達

relations.text: 北米の顧客向けに、Equinixなどのデータセンターの設備を賃借して提供している
relations.text_en: RingCentral serves North American customers from data center facilities where it leases space from Equinix and other providers

source.label: RingCentral 10-K
source.quote: We currently serve our North American customers from geographically disparate data center hosting facilities in North America, where we lease space from Equinix, Inc., and other providers, and we serve our European customers from third-party data center hosting facilities in Europe.

relations.text: コンタクトセンターやSMSの提供に、Bandwidth.comなどの第三者技術を使っている
relations.text_en: RingCentral uses third-party technology from Bandwidth.com and others to provide contact center and SMS solutions

source.label: RingCentral 10-K
source.quote: We currently use and/or provide third-party technology and integrations from NICE, Bandwidth.com, Inc., Microsoft Corporation and other companies to provide some of our solutions to our customers, including contact center and SMS solutions.

companies.name: NiCE
companies.sub: コンタクトセンターソフト

relations.text: コンタクトセンターなどの提供に、NICEなどの第三者技術を使っている
relations.text_en: RingCentral uses third-party technology from NICE and others to provide contact center solutions

source.label: RingCentral 10-K
source.quote: We currently use and/or provide third-party technology and integrations from NICE, Bandwidth.com, Inc., Microsoft Corporation and other companies to provide some of our solutions to our customers, including contact center and SMS solutions.

relations.text: 長年の提携関係をNiCEと延長した
relations.text_en: RingCentral extended its long-standing partnership with NiCE

source.label: RingCentral 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: We also extended our long-standing partnership with NiCE and we look forward to working with them, as we continue offering a best-in-class, integrated AI-powered cloud telephony and contact center suite that is the ideal choice for enterprises with complex and advanced use-cases.”

relations.text: NiCE CXone Mpowerを基盤とするRingCentral Contact Centerの販売について、複数年の契約延長をした
relations.text_en: RingCentral extended a multi-year agreement to market and sell RingCentral Contact Center, powered by NiCE CXone Mpower

source.label: RingCentral 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: NICE), through a multi-year extension of our long-term agreement to market and sell RingCentral Contact Center™, a proven, global solution for enterprise-grade customer engagement, powered by NiCE CXone Mpower.

relations.text: UnitedHealthcareから医療保険サービスを購入している
relations.text_en: The company purchased health insurance services from UnitedHealthcare, a subsidiary of UnitedHealth Group

source.label: RingCentral 10-K
source.quote: In the ordinary course of business, the Company purchased health insurance services from UnitedHealthcare, a subsidiary of UnitedHealth Group, a provider of health insurance services to the Company.
source.note: 子会社からの購入です。

relations.text: AT&Tが顧客向けにAIRの提供を始め、提携を拡大した
relations.text_en: Expanded partnership with AT&T, which began offering AIR to its customers

source.label: RingCentral 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: • Expanded partnership with AT&T, which began offering AIR to their customers, highlighting RingCentral’s and AT&T’s shared commitment to AI-powered business communications.

relations.text: AT&Tがクラウド型コンタクトセンターと会話インテリジェンスの提供を始められるようになった
relations.text_en: This enables AT&T to start offering cloud contact center and conversational intelligence to its customers

source.label: RingCentral 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: This enables AT&T to start offering cloud contact center and conversational intelligence to their customers, thus elevating customer engagement and experiences through AI-enabled technologies.

relations.text: GenpactがRingEXとRingCXを採用し、インド全22通信サークルで提供する
relations.text_en: RingEX and RingCX were selected by Genpact, with licensed availability across all 22 telecom circles in India

source.label: RingCentral 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: • RingEX & RingCX selected by Genpact, a global advanced technology services and solutions company with 125,000 employees in 30+ countries, to enable tighter collaboration and for RingCentral's licensed availability across all 22 telecom circles in India.

relations.text: Salesforceなど主要なCRMと連携している
relations.text_en: RingCentral integrates with CRMs including Salesforce

source.label: RingCentral 10-K
source.quote: ◦ Deep CRM integrations, including Salesforce, Zendesk, ServiceNow, HubSpot, Microsoft Dynamics, and others, ensuring customer interactions are context-aware and data-driven.

relations.text: RingCentralはMicrosoft Teamsに組み込まれ、Teams Phoneライセンスなしで利用できる
relations.text_en: RingCentral embeds into Microsoft Teams without requiring a Teams Phone license

source.label: RingCentral 10-K
source.quote: RingCentral seamlessly embeds into Microsoft Teams, providing reliable, global enterprise-grade phone, SMS, fax, and customer experience solutions — without requiring a Teams Phone license.

relations.text: RingCentralとOpenAIの提携が、Aragon ResearchによるRingCXの評価で言及されている
relations.text_en: Aragon Research cited the OpenAI partnership in naming RingCX a Leader

source.label: RingCentral 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: • Aragon Research named RingCX a Leader in its Intelligent Contact Center for SMB Globe report, specifically citing the OpenAI partnership as positioning RingCentral to lead the shift toward agentic voice AI across the full customer interaction lifecycle.

relations.text: モバイルOSの提供元としてAppleが挙げられ、同社との関係が成長に影響しうるとされている
relations.text_en: Apple is named as a provider of mobile operating systems, and problems in that relationship could hurt growth

source.label: RingCentral 10-K
source.quote: addition, if we experience difficulties in the future integrating our mobile applications into smart devices or if problems arise with our relationships with providers of mobile operating systems, such as those of Apple Inc. or Alphabet Inc., our future growth and our results of operations could suffer.
source.note: リスク要因としての記載です。

relations.text: モバイルOSの提供元としてAlphabetが挙げられ、同社との関係が成長に影響しうるとされている
relations.text_en: Alphabet is named as a provider of mobile operating systems, and problems in that relationship could hurt growth

source.quote: addition, if we experience difficulties in the future integrating our mobile applications into smart devices or if problems arise with our relationships with providers of mobile operating systems, such as those of Apple Inc. or Alphabet Inc., our future growth and our results of operations could suffer.
source.note: リスク要因としての記載です。

source.note: 資金調達のみの関係です。
